label: prop:meson-scale-independence
title: The meson mass scale $m_\pi$ is independent of $(m_\mathfrak{e}, q_0)$
html:
Proposition. The meson mass scale m_\pi is independent of (m_\mathfrak{e}, q_0)

The pion mass m_\pi cannot be derived from the substrate parameters (m_\mathfrak{e}, q_0) alone. The Hecke algebra determines the relative meson mass spectrum (character ratios between mesons) but not the absolute scale m_\pi.

Archimedean specialisation. The scale statement is evaluated over \mathbb{R} — hyperbolic volumes, the MeV meson scale, and the CAL-3 numerical calibration. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall.
